messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance - Saturday 23 November
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The DMS will be unavailable from 22:00 Saturday 23 November to 06:00 Sunday 24 November for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please check in any open documents before then. Email and the deal data rooms are unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
